title: Canonical representable-simplex homotopy-colimit resolution of a simplicial presheaf
statement: Use the universes of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], simplicial sets and the simplex category of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], the projective model structure of [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model], and homotopy colimits of [lem-coef-hocolim-reindexing-zigzags]. Write $\Delta^n_r=\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([r],[n])$ for the standard simplex, with operators given by precomposition; for $\alpha:[n]\to[m]$, $\Delta^\alpha:\Delta^n\to\Delta^m$ is postcomposition by $\alpha$. Let $D$ be a small ordinary category and $F:D^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathsf{sSet}$ a simplicial presheaf. Put $h_d(e)=\operatorname{Hom}_D(e,d)$, regarded as a discrete simplicial set. Define $E_F$ to have objects $(d,[n],\sigma)$, with $\sigma\in F(d)_n$. An arrow $(d,[n],\sigma)\to(e,[m],\tau)$ is a pair $a:d\to e$, $\alpha:[n]\to[m]$ such that $F(a)_n(F(e)(\alpha)(\tau))=\sigma$. Let $B_F:E_F\to\mathsf U(D)$ take this object to $h_d\times\Delta^n$ and this arrow to $h_a\times\Delta^\alpha$. Its evaluation cocone to $F$ has component at $(d,[n],\sigma)$ corresponding by Yoneda to $\sigma$. For every projectively cofibrant replacement $P B_F\to B_F$ in the diagram category $\mathsf U(D)^{E_F}$, the colimit $H_F=\operatorname{colim}_{E_F}P B_F$ is projectively cofibrant in $\mathsf U(D)$ and the induced evaluation augmentation $H_F\to F$ is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence. No fibrancy of $F$ or nonemptiness of $D$ is assumed.

source.place: Proposition 2.9, printed p. 152, with its proof in Section 9.1, printed pp. 170-171. No Stacks tag states this homotopical presheaf resolution.

proof.text:
The category $E_F$ is small: its objects form the small sum of the sets $F(d)_n$ over $d\in D$ and $n\in\mathbf N$, and each arrow set is a subset of $\operatorname{Hom}_D(d,e)\times\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([n],[m])$. Composition is $(a',\alpha')(a,\alpha)=(a'a,\alpha'\alpha)$; functoriality and naturality of $F$ preserve the defining equation. The evaluation formula is
$$\varepsilon_{d,n,\sigma}(x)_q(b,t)=F(b)_q\bigl(F(d)(t)\sigma\bigr),\qquad b:x\to d,\quad t:[q]\to[n].$$
For an arrow $(a,\alpha)$ the equation $F(a)F(e)(\alpha)\tau=\sigma$ makes these maps a cocone. Each $h_d\times\Delta^n$ is projectively cofibrant: by evaluation at $d$ (at the identity $1_d$ under Yoneda), a lifting problem against an objectwise trivial fibration is exactly a lifting problem from $\Delta^n$ against its value at $d$. This lifts since every simplicial set is cofibrant in the Kan model structure. The projective model structure and its lifting characterization are those in [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model]; monomorphism cofibrations are supplied by [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper].

source.place: Proposition 2.9 and Section 9.1, printed pp.152,170: small index, explicit evaluation and cofibrant values, expanded from the definitions.

proof.text: Set $I=E_F$, $\mathcal M=\mathsf U(D)$ and $V=B_F$. By [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model] this is a combinatorial simplicial model category; Step 1 gives a small index and cofibrant values. Apply [lem-coef-simplicial-bar-projective-resolution] to obtain a projectively cofibrant $QB_F\to B_F$ which is an objectwise weak equivalence, and put $R=\operatorname{colim}_{E_F}QB_F$. Its displayed coend formula and its compatibility with cocones identify its map $R\to F$ with the evaluation augmentation. The projective diagram model structure exists by [lem-coef-model-colimit-localization-comparison]. The adjunction $\operatorname{colim}_{E_F}\dashv\operatorname{const}$ is left Quillen: its right adjoint preserves fibrations and trivial fibrations because both are objectwise. Explicitly a lifting problem for $\operatorname{colim}C\to\operatorname{colim}C'$ against a (trivial) fibration is adjoint to the lifting problem for $C\to C'$ against its constant diagram. Hence colimit sends projective cofibrations and trivial cofibrations to those classes in $\mathsf U(D)$. In particular $R$ and the specified $H_F=\operatorname{colim}PB_F$ are projectively cofibrant.

source.place: Section 2.6 and Section 9.1, printed pp.151-152,170; the projective replacement model is made explicit by the general bar-resolution node (Primer 9.11 and 9.12).

proof.text:
Fix $x\in D$. Evaluation, tensors and colimits of simplicial presheaves are computed objectwise. Form the bisimplicial set
$$Z^x_{p,q}=\coprod_{i_0\to\cdots\to i_p\text{ in }E_F}\operatorname{Hom}_D(x,d_0)\times\operatorname{Hom}_\Delta([q],[n_0]),\qquad i_0=(d_0,[n_0],\sigma_0).$$
In the $p$ direction use the bar faces (the first one sends $(b,t)$ to $(a_1b,\alpha_1t)$); in the $q$ direction precompose $t$. These operators commute. The coend formula of Step 2 identifies $R(x)$ with $\operatorname{diag}Z^x$: in degree $r$ send a representative $(z\in Z^x_{p,r},\theta:[r]\to[p])$ to $Z^x(\theta,1)z\in Z^x_{r,r}$. The inverse sends $z$ to $(z,1_{[r]})$, and the coend relations show the two composites are identities. The evaluation formula of Step 1 gives an augmentation $Z^x_{p,q}\to F(x)_q$, independent of $p$, by $(i_0\to\cdots\to i_p,b,t)\mapsto F(b)_qF(d_0)(t)\sigma_0$. The arrow equation in $E_F$ verifies the first face; the other faces and all degeneracies preserve this value. Its diagonal is exactly $R(x)\to F(x)$.

source.place: Section 9.1, proof of Proposition 2.9, printed pp.170-171: agent-supplied direct bisimplicial expansion of the evaluated homotopy colimit.

proof.text: For a fixed $q$, let $C_{x,q}$ have objects $(d,[n],\sigma,b:x\to d,t:[q]\to[n])$ and arrows $(a,\alpha)$ in $E_F$ with $b'=ab$ and $t'=\alpha t$. A chain of $p$ arrows is determined by its chain in $E_F$ and its initial $(b,t)$, so its nerve in degree $p$ is exactly $Z^x_{p,q}$, with the same face and degeneracy operators. The label $\xi=F(b)_qF(d)(t)\sigma$ is constant on arrows. For every $\xi\in F(x)_q$, the object $c_\xi=(x,[q],\xi,1_x,1_{[q]})$ is initial among objects with that label: the unique arrow to $(d,[n],\sigma,b,t)$ is $(b,t)$, and its required $E_F$ equation is precisely the label equation. Define $h_{-1}(\xi)=c_\xi$ and define $h_p$ on a chain by prepending $c_\xi$ and this unique arrow. Deleting the inserted vertex gives $d_0h_p=1$; for a zero-chain deleting its old vertex gives $d_1h_0=h_{-1}\varepsilon$. Deleting or duplicating any old vertex before or after insertion gives respectively $d_{i+1}h_{p+1}=h_pd_i$ and $s_{i+1}h_p=h_{p+1}s_i$; also $\varepsilon h_{-1}=1$. Thus these are exactly extra-degeneracy data, including when the label set is empty.

source.place: Section 9.1, printed pp.170-171: explicit category-of-representations contraction replacing the Grothendieck-construction/cofinality calculation. The initial object and all extra-degeneracy identities are written out here.

proof.text: Apply [lem-coef-extra-degeneracy-contraction] to Step 4. It supplies a simplicial section of $Z^x_{\bullet,q}\to\operatorname{const}F(x)_q$ and a simplicial homotopy from section followed by augmentation to the identity. The other composite is the identity, with constant homotopy. Therefore [lem-cbc-simplicial-homotopy-equivalence-weak] makes this augmentation a weak homotopy equivalence. This is a statement about the whole augmented row, so no separate assertion about coproducts of contractible spaces is needed. Now apply [lem-coef-bisimplicial-diagonal-equivalence] with the $p$ direction as the weak-equivalence direction, to the bisimplicial augmentation $Z^x_{p,q}\to F(x)_q$. The target is constant in $p$ and has diagonal $F(x)$. We obtain that $R(x)\to F(x)$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. Since $x$ was arbitrary, $R\to F$ is a weak equivalence in the projective presheaf model structure.

source.place: Section 9.1, printed pp.169-171: extra-degeneracy and bisimplicial diagonal arguments. The row contraction is supplied in Step 4 rather than hidden in a cofinality claim.

proof.text:
Write $Q=QB_F$ and $P=PB_F$, both projectively cofibrant diagrams over $B_F$, with objectwise weak-equivalence augmentations. In the projective diagram model category of [lem-coef-model-colimit-localization-comparison], factor their joint augmentation as
$$Q\amalg P\xrightarrow{j}T\xrightarrow{p}B_F,$$
with $j$ a cofibration and $p$ a trivial fibration. The coproduct $Q\amalg P$ and then $T$ are cofibrant: a lift from a coproduct is a pair of lifts, and cofibrations compose by their lifting property. Let $u:Q\to T$ and $v:P\to T$ be the two inclusions followed by $j$. Both are weak equivalences by two-out-of-three, since $pu$ and $pv$ are the original augmentations. The left Quillen colimit functor of Step 2 preserves weak equivalences between cofibrant objects by [lem-coef-model-infinity-derived-adjunction]. Consequently $\operatorname{colim}u:R\to\operatorname{colim}T$ and $\operatorname{colim}v:H_F\to\operatorname{colim}T$ are weak equivalences. The map $\operatorname{colim}T\to F$ induced by $p$ and the evaluation cocone composes with the first to $R\to F$ and with the second to the required $H_F\to F$, by the colimit universal property. Step 5 and two-out-of-three first make $\operatorname{colim}T\to F$ and then $H_F\to F$ weak equivalences. This argument only uses the specified replacement's weak equivalence and cofibrant source; it does not assume its augmentation is a trivial fibration. No fibrant replacement of $F$ was used. If $D$ is empty, both presheaves are the unique object; if $F$ is empty-valued, $E_F$ is empty and the same colimit argument applies.

source.place: Section 9.1, conclusion of Proposition 2.9, printed p.171. Agent-supplied common-factorization comparison proves independence of every projective cofibrant-replacement choice.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q92-7cfa08ae9 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: I read all six steps of the item, the new node lem-coef-simplicial-bar-projective-resolution in full, and the statement of every cited node. Item statement: unchanged, true, and it matches what the parent lem-coef-cosimplicial-presheaf-counit (Steps 3-4) uses. I checked the edge cases D empty, F empty-valued, D terminal, and D with automorphisms. Step 1: E_F is small, the evaluation cocone is well-typed, and h_d x Delta^n is cofibrant (by Yoneda the lift reduces to emptyset->Delta^n against a trivial Kan fibration). Step 2: the hypotheses of the bar lemma hold, since U(D) is a combinatorial simplicial model category and B_F has cofibrant values. colim is left Quillen by adjoint lifting. Step 3: the co-Yoneda identification of the coend with diag Z^x checks out, including the first bar face, the augmentation (by naturality of F(a_1)) and the diagonal. Step 4: the initial object c_xi is unique even when D has automorphisms, and every extra-degeneracy identity matches the cited node's list exactly. Step 5: extra-degeneracy gives a homotopy equivalence, hence a weak equivalence, and the bisimplicial diagonal lemma applies in the exchanged direction with the correct orientation. Step 6: the common cofibration/trivial-fibration factorization, the clause that left Quillen functors preserve weak equivalences between cofibrant objects, and two-out-of-three are correct; it does not assume P->B_F is a trivial fibration. New node: true (free diagrams, latching maps are summand inclusions, so the realization is Reedy-cofibrant; the extra degeneracy comes from appending id_j; colim by co-Yoneda), with edge cases I empty, discrete and terminal. It is self-contained, statement-only, carries searches of all three kinds, and is neither a duplicate nor a restated item clause. I compared it with lem-coef-bousfield-kan-comparison-calculus, lem-coef-hocolim-reindexing-zigzags, lem-coef-model-colimit-localization-comparison, lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus and lem-coef-combinatorial-cofibrant-density. No cycle. Accepted tool_use: lem-cbc-simplicial-homotopy-equivalence-weak (unit sk-prop-sf-cbc); no node in this unit states that implication. Caveat: the Dugger sources are online only and have no archived copy, so I could not reopen the cited pages here. I verified the mathematics directly instead, and proof_origin is correctly marked agent. No fixes.

lean.statement: theorem simplex_hocolim_resolution {D : Type u} [SmallCategory D] (F : Dᵒᵖ ⥤ SSet.{u}) {m : ModelCategory (Dᵒᵖ ⥤ SSet.{u})} (hm : IsProjectivePresheafModel m) : ∃ (ε : SimplexEvaluationCocone F), ∀ (R : SimplexProjectiveReplacement F m), m.categoryWithCofibrations.cofibrations (initial.to (colimit R.P)) ∧ ∀ (d : Dᵒᵖ), Enhanced.IsWeakHomotopyEquivalence ((colimit.desc R.P { pt := F ι := R.map ≫ ε.leg }).app d)
